image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vintage-style porcelain teacup and saucer set resting on a pink textured fabric. The cup features a floral pattern with pink roses, blue flowers, and green leaves, accented by gold rims on the lip and base. It has a classic C-shaped handle. The saucer matches the cup's design with a scalloped edge and gold trim.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cup/teacup and distinguish it from other vessels like bowls or vases.
Handles are common failure points in AI generation (floating or melting into the body); this expert will verify the handle's structural connectivity.
To check for texture anomalies, smearing, or logical inconsistencies in the complex floral decals and gold trim.
To ensure the cup sits physically correctly on the saucer without clipping or floating artifacts.

focus_areas: Continuity of the gold rim (no breaks or warping)
Logic of the floral pattern (consistent perspective and detail)
Contact shadow between cup and saucer
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle's connection to the cup body. AI often fails to render the negative space within the handle loop correctly or blends the handle into the cup wall. Also, verify that the gold trim follows the curvature of the rim and base without wavering or disappearing.
